description: The closed set of truth-response classifications a Payload OS API response may carry, and what a frontend must render for each. API-000 requires every response to say which of two shapes it is; this refines that into seven named classes, three of which are successes and four of which are typed non-successes. The point of the four is that they must survive to the screen: a non-success rendered as a zero, a blank that looks complete, or green health is the exact failure API-000 exists to prevent.

invariant.statement: A frontend renders the truth class it was given. It never upgrades a class, never substitutes a value for a typed non-success, and never styles an observation as a verified fact.
invariant.why: The response already says what it is worth. Everything after that is a rendering decision, and the only rendering decision that can destroy the guarantee is one that makes an unknown look like a known.

CANONICAL_PROOF.means: The answer is canonical state, addressable by a canonical reference and checkable against the proof root that carries it.
must_not: Present the proof root as evidence that the underlying empirical source content is true. It is a provenance and caching key: it proves what was recorded, not that what was recorded is so.

VERIFIED_DERIVATION.means: The answer is derived, and the derivation is itself verifiable: the inputs, the transformation and the envelope root are available for inspection.
must_not: Render as canonical state. A derivation is only as good as the inputs it names, and the frontend must let a reader reach them.

OPERATIONAL_OBSERVATION.means: One process's opinion of itself or of something it reached, at a moment. Not canonical state.
must_not: Show with an empty limitations list — an observation with no stated limits is not an observation, it is an unsupported claim.

UNOBSERVED.means: Nothing has looked. The subject exists and no observation of it has been recorded.
must_not: Render as zero, empty, healthy, or as a dash that reads as none.
Be omitted from a count of what is known.

UNRESOLVED.means: The identity could not be resolved to a single subject with the evidence available.
must_not: Pick a candidate for the reader.
Render as a single resolved identity with a confidence adornment.

CONFLICTING.means: Two or more evidenced answers disagree, and nothing in the corpus settles which is right.
must_not: Show the most recent, the most common, or the highest-scoring as the answer.
Average, merge or reconcile the positions.

NOT_EVIDENCED.means: The question is answerable in principle but no admitted evidence bears on it.
must_not: Render as a negative finding — no evidence of a thing is not evidence of no thing.

frame.description: The release-first frame every consequential view carries, so that a reader knows what they are looking at before they read what it says.
frame.note: Coverage is the evidence state of the slice, not a score. Provenance path is bounded: a drill-down requests a separately authorized view and is never derived from an artifact id or digest alone.

frontend_boundary.description: What a browser client of Payload OS may do, and what it may never be given. This restates the estate's existing boundaries at the frontend, rather than inventing a second security model.

cross_line_views.rule: A view spanning two lines is labelled a governed mapping.
must_not: Suggest causal or commercial authority between lines.
Infer market price from movement, delivery from market data, or land entitlement from either.

control_plane_visual.rule: The control-plane visual model is logical topology only.
must_not: Add coordinates that were not supplied.
Present a logical layout as geography.
control_plane_visual.deltas: Chronological verified transitions only; a missing snapshot is a gap, never a synthesized state.
